text: To reset your password open Settings and choose Reset password. We email a reset link that expires in one hour.
To change your email open Settings then Profile and edit the email field. Confirm the change from the link we send.
A duplicate charge usually means a pending authorisation and a final charge. The pending one drops off within five days.
If both charges stay, contact billing with your invoice number so we can refund the extra charge.
You can cancel any time and get a refund within thirty days of purchase. Refunds return to the original card.
The premium plan adds unlimited workspaces, priority support and data export.
You are signed out after thirty minutes of inactivity. Choose Keep me signed in on the login page to stay signed in longer.
Export your data from Settings then Data. Choose CSV to open it in a spreadsheet.
Add a teammate from Workspace then Members. Enter their email and pick a role.
If push notifications stop, check that notifications are allowed for the app in your phone settings.
Two factor authentication asks for a code from your phone each time you log in, on top of your password.
Edit the company name on invoices from Billing then Company details. New invoices use the new name.
To delete your account permanently go to Settings then Danger zone. This cannot be undone.
